text: Adds several different powerful effects to Hero Memories, including Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.
After the Memory Revival feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can Revive Hero Memories at [Pristine Lunar String Cynthia] in the Town.
There are 3 types of Memory Revival: New Moon Revival, Half-Moon Revival, and Full Moon Revival, each of which unlocks different crafting effects for Memories of different tiers.
New Moon Revival includes: Young Moon
Half-Moon Revival includes: Wax and Wane and Young Moon
Full Moon Revival includes: Wax and Wane, Rising Moon, Young Moon, and Young Moon: Lunar Phase.
Using Memory Revival materials randomly grants the following effects to Hero Memories:
Wax and Wane: Increases Base Stat values
Rising Moon: Increases the tiers of Fixed Affixes
Young Moon: Adds an additional Revived Affix. Using a targeted Revival Material "Lunar Phase" has a chance to add a targeted Revived Affix (Lunar Phase)
Each module has its own success rate and does not affect each other. The effect will be granted upon success.

Revived Hero Memories can be revived again. Reviving again randomly re-rolls from the initial state, with the option to keep the result before or after revival. Different Memories have a maximum limit on revival attempts. Materials consumed per revival increase with the number of attempts and stop increasing upon reaching the limit. Choosing to keep the result before revival will still consume materials and revival attempts.
You can only install 1 Revived Hero Memory.
When performing Full Moon Revival, if a Revived Affix (Lunar Phase) was not obtained after using a targeted Revival material, the Revived Hero Memory will become bound.
1. Using Memory Revival materials randomly grants the following effects to Hero Memories:

Rising Moon: Increases the tiers of Fixed Affixes
Young Moon: Adds an additional Revived Affix. Using the targeted revival material "Lunar Phase" has a chance to add a targeted Revived Affix (Lunar Phase)
2. Each effect above has its own success rate and does not interact with the others. You gain the effect on success.

3. Revived Hero Memories can be revived again. Reviving again randomly re-rolls from the initial state, with the option to keep the result before or after revival. Different Memories have a maximum limit on revival attempts, and cannot be revived further once the limit is reached.

4. Materials are consumed for each revival, and the consumption increases with the number of attempts until reaching the limit. Choosing to keep the result before revival will still consume materials and revival attempts.
5. Each character can install at most 1 revived Hero Memory.
